policy: Wave-1 design constraint: NO edits to src/fw_context_mcp/** (the substrate). Every Track-B substrate finding is handed off as a pre-drafted pull request for a maintainer to file; none is actioned inside wave-1. Agent code never patches the substrate it runs on.

pull_requests.title: fix(index): per-config manifest hashing for multi-variant projects
pull_requests.summary: G02 (same source compiled twice with -DMODE_VALUE=1/2): the per-config build truth collides — one config's defines/regions can be served for the other.
pull_requests.proposed_pr_body: Key the index manifest by compile_commands config hash instead of source path alone; add a regression test compiling one TU twice with different -D sets and asserting distinct conditional regions per config.
pull_requests.wave1_exposure: exercised indirectly by I7 (CONFIG_DISABLE_ENVIRON pinning); agent-side mitigation: build_snapshot_id pinning (E2/GA-4) refuses foreign-build facts

pull_requests.title: fix(build): stop variants sharing a mutable compile_commands artifact
pull_requests.summary: G04 (bare build + [[build.variants]] A/B/C): variants share one mutable compile_commands artifact; the last variant can overwrite build truth for earlier ones.
pull_requests.proposed_pr_body: Materialize a per-variant compile_commands copy under .fw-context/build/<config_hash>/ at index time; fail closed when the active config hash mismatches the served one.
pull_requests.wave1_exposure: agent-side mitigation only: round drivers freeze one build per round and record build_snapshot_id on every fact

pull_requests.title: fix(callgraph): resolve transitive function-pointer registration flows
pull_requests.summary: G06 (callbacks.c): direct function-pointer flows resolve, transitive registration flow does not.
pull_requests.proposed_pr_body: During index, record registration call-sites as registration edges (registrant -> registered) and expand them in find_call_path/find_all_callers_recursive; add the two-level registration regression from G06.
pull_requests.wave1_exposure: wave-1 K2 uses direct flows only (C1 submit-site check) — exposure bounded to indirect-flow families deferred to wave 2

pull_requests.title: fix(deadcode): linker-root discovery for compile_commands-only projects
pull_requests.summary: G07 (dead/keep): compile_commands-only projects can lack roots/linker evidence and mislabel live entry chains graph_unreachable.
pull_requests.proposed_pr_body: Treat missing linker evidence as unknown, not unreachable: emit binary_status=unknown and keep such symbols out of dead verdicts; regression on the G07 dead/keep fixture without a link script.
pull_requests.wave1_exposure: not load-bearing in wave-1 (no dead-code families admitted); recorded for wave-2 family admission

pull_requests.title: fix(index): persist bodies for single-line definitions
pull_requests.summary: Any function whose entire definition spans one source line stores empty source; F-V1-002 is an instance.
pull_requests.proposed_pr_body: When end_line == line, store the line text as the body and mark completeness accordingly; regression: single-line definition must return non-empty source.
pull_requests.wave1_exposure: agent-side mitigation: the T2/G4 single-line discipline (E3 >=2-surface cross-check) treats single-line surfaces as never load-bearing — I8 proves the quarantine

pull_requests.title: feat(search): pagination for capped result sets
pull_requests.summary: lookup_symbol/search_bodies/search_content cap results at limit<=100 with no pagination.
pull_requests.proposed_pr_body: Add an opaque cursor to the three search tools returning capped sets; document that absence of a cursor is required for any absence-style claim.
pull_requests.wave1_exposure: agent-side mitigation: G7 truncation detector marks capped answers truncated_lower_bound and K2 forbids complete-enumeration claims on them

pull_requests.title: fix(vectors): recognize standard CMSIS6 C-form vector tables
pull_requests.summary: get_vector_table returns false 'No vector table' for the standard CMSIS 6 startup in C form.
pull_requests.proposed_pr_body: Extend vector recognition to C-form tables (array-of-function-pointers with section attribute), not only assembly .word tables; regression with the CMSIS6 startup pattern.
pull_requests.wave1_exposure: none in wave-1 cases (C1/C4/C5/C6 use no vector tables); recorded for wave-2 boot-path families

pull_requests.title: fix(lookup): honor exact=True (no silent fallback)
pull_requests.summary: lookup_symbol with exact=True silently relaxes to an unrelated-symbol fallback when no exact match exists.
pull_requests.proposed_pr_body: When exact=True and no match, return an empty result plus _did_you_mean; never a relaxed row. Regression: exact lookup of a nonexistent symbol must not return unrelated symbols.
pull_requests.wave1_exposure: agent-side mitigation: G6 fallback-row rejection (E-TIER-FALLBACK) drops any row carrying _fallback/_did_you_mean provenance before it can become a fact — exercised in I5 plant package PT-G6 and in the I7 absence-soundness work

verifier_note: The fresh verifier (23-check audit) confirms this file exists and that no entry was actioned inside implementation/fault_discovery_agent or src/fw_context_mcp.
